title: 12-Hour and 24-Hour Clock: Conversion Table, Rules and the Midnight Trap on Train Tickets
seoTitle: 12 Hour and 24 Hour Clock: Conversion Table and Rules
seoDescription: To convert p.m. to 24-hour time, add 12 (4:30 p.m. = 16:30); 12 a.m. becomes 00. Full table, train-ticket midnight trap and worked duration examples.
excerpt: A full conversion table, the two hours that cause most mistakes, how to read 00:15 on an IRCTC ticket without missing your train, and worked examples for overnight journeys and time zones.
